noSecondCodeCorrection.measuredHarnessDefectLeftIN_PLACE: walkTo compares the achieved step against expected = max(0.02, pulse.commandedUnits * 0.25), but planPulseMs returns commandedUnits as the FULL desired distance even when ms is clamped to maxMs. With the live calibration (0.004955 u/ms) a 400 ms ceiling can only deliver ~1.99 u, so on any leg longer than ~8 u EVERY pulse is scored a stall and the leg dies after 10 pulses (stallMs 7000).

noSecondCodeCorrection.consequence: reference-1 and reference-2 are preserved as invalidated attempts and are NOT deleted.
